How subscribing works

Subscribing (as opposed to downloading once) means your calendar app periodically re-fetches the URL and automatically picks up new or changed events as this project's daily build updates them.

  • Google Calendar — Other calendars → + → From URL, paste the https:// link.
  • Apple Calendar — File → New Calendar Subscription, paste the link (the webcal:// version works too).
  • Outlook — Add calendar → Subscribe from web, paste the https:// link.
  • TickTick — Settings → Calendar Subscription, paste the https:// link.

TechCalendar is an independent, unofficial project and is not affiliated with Google, Apple, Samsung, Microsoft, or OpenAI.
